## Design

### 2026-11-06: I started creating the schematic and pcb for my devboard. One obstacle was that the guide had a crystal that had 4 pins, but all my crysta symbols had 3 or less. It seemed that the more recent crystal

**5h**

I started creating the schematic and pcb for my devboard. One obstacle was that the guide had a crystal that had 4 pins, but all my crysta symbols had 3 or less. It seemed that the more recent crystal oscillators only have 3 pins, so I had to adjust for that. Following the guide was pretty easy, and I had a lot of time to design the board. Once I find my pcb images I'll put it in the next entry.

### 2026-11-08: This took the longest time. The PCB, I had followed the guide so good so far, however, since I was a beginner, I ran into simple mistakes that costed me time to fix. I literally had to update my PCB l

**11h**

This took the longest time. The PCB, I had followed the guide so good so far, however, since I was a beginner, I ran into simple mistakes that costed me time to fix. I literally had to update my PCB like 5 times in the schematic editor just to get the board have the correct pins, the correct SMD pads, and I also had to use a bunch of direct positioning tools to move the SMD pads around so that the wiring can be optimal. Then there was the vias. SO MANY VIASES. My thermal relief map also looks a bit weird but I had to make my viases were placed correctly. Then I had to solve all the unconnected errors which was a hastle.
